arxiv-2003-08798.title: Incremental Object Detection via Meta-Learning
arxiv-2003-08798.creator: K J Joseph, Jathushan Rajasegaran, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Vineeth N Balasubramanian
arxiv-2003-08798.description: Abstract In a real-world setting, object instances from new classes can be continuously encountered by object detectors. When existing object detectors are applied to such scenarios, their performance on old classes deteriorates significantly. A few efforts have been reported to address this limitation, all of which apply variants of knowledge distillation to avoid catastrophic forgetting.

arxiv-2109-04753.title: Line as a Visual Sentence: Context-aware Line Descriptor for Visual Localization
arxiv-2109-04753.creator: Sungho Yoon, Ayoung Kim
arxiv-2109-04753.description: Abstract Along with feature points for image matching, line features provide additional constraints to solve visual geometric problems in robotics and CV ( CV ). Although recent CNN ( CNN )-based line descriptors are promising for viewpoint changes or dynamic environments, we claim that the CNN architecture has innate disadvantages to abstract variable line length into the fixed-dimensional descriptor.

arxiv-2110-12536.title: Neo : Generalizing Confusion Matrix Visualization to Hierarchical and Multi-Output Labels Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 29-May 5, 2022; New Orleans, LA, USA CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’22), April 29-May 5, 2022, New Orleans, LA
arxiv-2110-12536.creator: Jochen Görtler, Fred Hohman, Dominik Moritz, Kanit Wongsuphasawat, Donghao Ren, Rahul Nair, Marc Kirchner, Kayur Patel
arxiv-2110-12536.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jochen Görtler, Fred Hohman, Dominik Moritz, Kanit Wongsuphasawat, Donghao Ren, Rahul Nair, Marc Kirchner, Kayur Patel. The confusion matrix, a ubiquitous visualization for helping people evaluate machine learning models, is a tabular layout that compares predicted class labels against actual class labels over all data instances. We conduct formative research with machine learning practitioners at Apple and find that conventional confusion matrices do not support more complex data-structures found in modern-day applications, such as hierarchical and multi-output labels.

arxiv-2410-04310.title: Harnessing Ionic Complexity: A Modeling Approach for Hierarchical Ionic Circuit Design
arxiv-2410-04310.creator: Max Tepermeister and Meredith N. Silberstein Sibley School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Cornell University, Ithaca, NY, United States
arxiv-2410-04310.description: Abstract S ince the 1950s, soft ionic devices have evolved from individual components to an expanding library of sensors, actuators, signal transmitters, and processors. However, integrating these components into complex, multi-functional systems remains challenging due to the non-intuitive and non-linear interactions between ionic elements.

arxiv-2504-19475.title: Prisma : An Open Source Toolkit for Mechanistic Interpretability in Vision and Video
arxiv-2504-19475.creator: Sonia Joseph, Praneet Suresh, Lorenz Hufe, Edward Stevinson, Robert Graham, Yash Vadi, Danilo Bzdok, Sebastian Lapuschkin, Lee Sharkey, Blake Aaron Richards
arxiv-2504-19475.description: Abstract Robust tooling and publicly available pre-trained models have helped drive recent advances in mechanistic interpretability for language models. However, similar progress in vision mechanistic interpretability has been hindered by the lack of accessible frameworks and pre-trained weights. We present Prisma 1 1 1 Access the codebase here: https://github.

pmc-10670961.title: Community Exercise Program Participation and Mental Well-Being in the U.S. Texas–Mexico Border Region
pmc-10670961.creator: Alma G. Ochoa Del-Toro, Lisa A. Mitchell-Bennett, Michael Machiorlatti, Candace A. Robledo, Amanda C. Davé, Rebecca N. Lozoya, Belinda M. Reininger
pmc-10670961.description: Hispanics are disproportionately affected by low rates of physical activity and high rates of chronic diseases. Hispanics generally and Mexican Americans specifically are underrepresented in research on physical activity and its impact on mental well-being. Some community-based interventions have been effective in increasing physical activity among Hispanics.

pmc-10671913.title: Digital Evaluation of Vertical Ridge Augmentation with the Modified Shell Technique Using a Xenogeneic Bone Lamina: A Case Series
pmc-10671913.creator: Arndt Happe, Sarah M Blender, Ralph G Luthardt, Heike Rudolph, Katharina Kuhn, Gianna Dipalma, Jan Cosyn
pmc-10671913.description: Vertical ridge augmentation is a demanding and technique-sensitive surgical procedure. In the present case series, cone beam CT (CBCT) scans from the clinical routine of patients treated using a novel approach for vertical bone augmentation were assessed. All patients showed a single-tooth class 5 defect and were treated using a modification of the original shell technique.

pmc-10698835.title: Clinically Silent, Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma Detected on Routine Screening Mammogram: A Report of a Rare Case and Review of Literature
pmc-10698835.creator: Elizabeth Pernicone, Kelly Fabrega-Foster
pmc-10698835.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is the most common and the most lethal urogenital malignancy, and can metastasize rapidly via hematogenous spread. Even so, RCC metastasis within the breast is extremely rare and may appear deceptively benign on screening mammograms. In this article, we present a rare case of RCC that remained undiagnosed until an intra-mammary metastasis was detected on a routine screening mammogram.

pmc-11432047.title: Association of Titin Polymorphisms with the Progression of Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Its Clinicopathological Characteristics
pmc-11432047.creator: Ching-Hui Hsu, Mu-Kuan Chen, Yu-Sheng Lo, Hsin-Yu Ho, Chia-Chieh Lin, Yi-Ching Chuang, Ming-Ju Hsieh, Ming-Chih Chou, Zoltán Wiener
pmc-11432047.description: This study examined the correlation of titin (TTN) polymorphisms with the sensitivity of oral squamous cell cancer (OSCC) and clinical characteristics. Six TTN SNPs, including rs10497520, rs12463674, rs12465459, rs2042996, rs2244492, and rs2303838, were evaluated in 322 control groups and 606 patients with oral cancer. We then investigated whether the SNP genotypes rs10497520 had associations with clinical pathological categories.

pmc-11532185.title: Comprehensive liquid biopsy analysis for monitoring NSCLC patients under second-line osimertinib treatment
pmc-11532185.creator: Aliki Ntzifa, Theodoros Marras, Galatea Kallergi, Athanasios Kotsakis, Vasilis Georgoulias, Evi Lianidou
pmc-11532185.description: BackgroundThe heterogeneous and complex genetic landscape of NSCLC impacts the clinical outcomes of patients who will eventually develop resistance to osimertinib. Liquid biopsy (LB) analysis as a minimally invasive approach is a key step to efficiently identify resistance mechanisms and adjust to proper subsequent treatments.

pmc-11672214.title: Nonemissive Iridium(III) Solvent Complex as a Self-Reporting Photosensitizer for Monitoring Phototherapeutic Efficacy in a “Signal on” Mode
pmc-11672214.creator: Manping Qian, Ke Wang, Peng Yang, Yu Liu, Meng Li, Chengxiao Zhang, Honglan Qi
pmc-11672214.description: Photodynamic therapy (PDT) has long been receiving increasing attention for the minimally invasive treatment of cancer. The performance of PDT depends on the photophysical and biological properties of photosensitizers (PSs). The always-on fluorescence signal of conventional PSs makes it difficult to real-time monitor phototherapeutic efficacy in the PDT process.

pmc-12617432.title: Early risk detection of metabolic syndrome using sex-specific machine learning models in military personnel
pmc-12617432.creator: Wei-Yun Wang, Yi-Syuan Wu, Yen Huang, Wen-Chii Tzeng
pmc-12617432.description: Metabolic syndrome is a critical predictor of future cardiometabolic disease and an emerging public health concern, particularly in high-demand populations such as military personnel. This study aimed to develop and evaluate sex-specific machine learning models for the early detection of metabolic syndrome using annual health check data.

pmc-12706059.title: The interaction of gait characteristics and concerns about falling in community-dwelling older adults
pmc-12706059.creator: Sabine Britting, Sebastian Krumpoch, Ulrich Lindemann, Anja Müller, Nicolas Rohleder, Toby Jack Ellmers, Alex Burkard, Ellen Freiberger, Robert Kob
pmc-12706059.description: Concerns about falling (CaF) are common in older adults and are associated with increased falls. Although cautious gait—a gait pattern linked to CaF—has been described, the specific gait parameters most strongly associated with CaF remain unclear. This study investigates the association between gait characteristics at normal and maximal gait speed and CaF in community-dwelling older adults.

pmc-13117986.title: Beneficial Effects of Olive Oil and the Mediterranean Diet on Alzheimer’s Disease and Vascular Dementia: A Review
pmc-13117986.creator: Aitor González-Cidad, Juan Carlos García-Moncó, Gustavo C. Román
pmc-13117986.description: Background and Objectives: During the past 25 years, a significant body of research has been conducted reporting on the salutary effects of the Mediterranean diet and extra-virgin olive oil, one of its main components. The initial studies were epidemiological observations on populations with very low mortality rates due to significant reductions in myocardial infarction fatalities.

pmc-13272519.title: Camel calf morbidity and mortality in low-income settings: Critical risk factors revealed by a cohort investigation in eastern Ethiopia
pmc-13272519.creator: Ambachew Motbaynor Wubaye, Abdusabur Mustefa, Welelew Edmew Worku, Alubel Alemu, Yihenew Getahun Ambaw, Shihun Shimelis, Mina Ali, Simegnew Adugna Kallu
pmc-13272519.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The morbidity and mortality of camel calves remain persistent problems in Ethiopia. This study aims to assess the incidence of camel calf morbidity and mortality and identify its predictors in the Dire Dawa administrative council, eastern Ethiopia. A questionnaire-based cross-sectional survey, along with a longitudinal follow-up study, was conducted on 385 purposively selected households to assess camel calf morbidity and mortality. Descriptive analysis was employed to examine the occurrence of calf morbidity and mortality.

pmc-13551089.title: Incorporating Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Into the History of the Japan Primary Care Association
pmc-13551089.creator: Makiko Ozaki
pmc-13551089.description: nse, infectious disease activities, academic awards, and interprofessional training. I appreciate this effort to document JPCA's first 15 years and its contributions to primary care in Japan. This account, however, would be more complete if it incorporated a diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) perspective.

pmc-13600136.title: The Evolution of Artificial Intelligence in Antibody Design: From Structure-Based Engineering to Generative Models
pmc-13600136.creator: Ida Szataniak, Kacper Packi
pmc-13600136.description: Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed computational antibody engineering by enabling accurate prediction of antibody structures, rational optimization of therapeutic properties, and de novo antibody design. Recent advances in deep learning, protein language models, and generative AI have fundamentally changed the way antibodies are discovered and engineered.

pmc-13621520.title: Grx2 deficiency accelerates BMSC senescence and senile osteoporosis via CD36 S-glutathionylation
pmc-13621520.creator: Muzhe Li, Taxi Wumiti, Jie Sun, Tianchi Zhang, Lining Wang, Qinfeng Zhou, Tianwei Xia, Jirong Shen, Yafeng Zhang, Yong Ma, Yang Guo
pmc-13621520.description: RationaleSenile osteoporosis (SOP) is driven largely by bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell (BMSC) senescence and mitochondrial dysfunction. S-glutathionylation is an important redox modification regulating mitochondrial homeostasis, yet its role in skeletal aging remains unclear. The objective of this study is to systematically investigate the role of Grx2 deficiency-mediated CD36 S-glutathionylation in BMSC senescence and SOP development.
